title: DITING: A Multi-Agent Evaluation Framework for Benchmarking Web Novel Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating translated Chinese web novel sentences using expert annotations and an LLM-based multi-agent framework (AgentEval) to ensure the outputs adapt culture-specific expressions reasonably and avoid culturally inappropriate, offensive, or biased translations.

Assessed as part of the 'Cultural Safety' and 'Value Alignment' evaluation dimensions, measuring whether translation models avoid generating discriminatory, biased, or harmful language when handling sensitive topics like gender.

Assessed as part of the 'Cultural Safety' evaluation dimension, checking whether translation models safely handle sensitive topics like religion without introducing biased, inappropriate, or socially misaligned expressions.
